items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... whether it’s Roy Hargrove or Joshua Redman and others ... see how now the setting has changed. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, you mean in other words they can get themselves a manager ...

ctx.x: O.k. Roy Hargrove, trumpet. What about saxophone? Doesn’t matter alto or tenor.
